title: Mixed Use Property Finance UK
summary: Search-result title for the page is 'Mixed Use Property Finance UK'. The search tool's summaries describe the page as presenting Silver Oak Capital as a specialist in mixed-use finance, which the page also calls semi-commercial finance: a mortgage product designed specifically for properties that consist of both a residential element and a commercial element under a single freehold or leasehold title (e.g. shops with flats above, commercial-residential assets). Lenders assess these differently from buy-to-let loans because income comes from both commercial leases and residential tenancies. The page also covers owner-occupiers who run a business from the ground floor. No loan sizes, LTVs, rates, fees, durations, process steps, testimonials or calls to action from this specific page were surfaced. Related mixed-use content came from the site's /faq/ page (vacant commercial units, challenger banks and bridging lenders, 12-month tenant-finding period with interest-only servicing, pricing between BTL and pure commercial), the /property-development-finance/ page (mixed-use projects, 300+ lenders) and /property-portfolio-mortgages/ (portfolios can include semi-commercial units). The third query ('loan to value') returned nothing from Silver Oak on mixed-use terms.
